choice_rows.label: Item 24 overpayment disposition
options: To be issued a Tax Credit Certificate

validation.how: red text under each field via get_error() for year-end month, attached sheets, schedule rows and others; messages with no input control appear only under 'Copy Errors' and as a section icon

findings.now: When Item 13 conflicts with the profile's election, or the profile's own election conflicts, Submit only sets 'Fix validation errors to continue.' and no message appears beside the field.
findings.why: item_13_election and annual_income_tax_election have no get_error() call in the view, so the only signals are a section icon (has_section_error, line 1617) and the Copy Errors text (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_2551q.rs:1410-1416 and 1469-1479).

options.name: Inline under the control
options.detail: Render get_error("item_13_election") under the Item 13 choices and get_error("annual_income_tax_election") under the Filing period header.

options.name: Summary list
options.detail: Add a 'Needs review' list that prints every message, as the 2552 page does at views/form_2552_view.rs:1504-1505.

findings.now: The year-end error reads 'Fiscal year-end month must be a whole number from 1 to 12', and the overpayment error reads 'Select exactly one disposition for this overpayment.', so the official alerts are not used.
findings.why: The official alerts 'Please enter valid Year Ended month on item 2.' and 'Please select overpayment option.' (rules/forms/2551q-v2018/validations.json) appear nowhere in crates/, and 12 of the 27 official messages in that file are missing.

options.name: Use the official text
options.detail: Show the official alert text verbatim, in official order, as the message for these checks.

options.name: Official text plus hint
options.detail: Show the official text as the message and keep the friendlier explanation as a hint under it.

findings.now: Add ATC Line accepts up to 22 distinct ATC lines, but a return with more than six lines cannot be queued, so the user can build a draft that cannot be filed in the app.
findings.why: MAX_EDITABLE_SCHEDULE_1_ROWS equals ATC_TABLE_2551Q.len() (22), while FORM_2551Q_XML_SCHEDULE_ROW_CAPACITY is 6 (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_2551q.rs:43) and the official layout has six ATC slots.

options.name: Cap at six
options.detail: Limit the list to the six official slots and direct larger schedules to a separate filing.

options.name: Block the seventh line
options.detail: Keep 22 options but show an inline message on the seventh line that queueing needs an attachment protocol.

findings.now: The button labelled 'Submit' only queues the return for background submission, and the page does not say that nothing has reached BIR yet.
findings.why: submit_btn calls mark_submitted, while the 2552 page labels the same action 'Queue for submission' (views/form_2552_view.rs:1443).

options.name: Rename
options.detail: Use 'Queue for submission', as the 2552 page does.

options.name: Confirm dialog
options.detail: Show a confirmation that the return is queued and not yet received by BIR.

findings.now: Copy Errors puts 'field: message' lines on the clipboard using internal keys such as 'tin' and 'item_13_election'.
findings.why: The toolbar joins validation_errors as format!("{field}: {message}"), so the copied text does not use the labels shown on the page.

options.name: Use labels
options.detail: Map each key to its on-page label before copying.

options.name: Copy messages only
options.detail: Copy the official message text alone, one per line.

findings.now: Calendar/Fiscal, the Item 13 election and the overpayment disposition are round radio dots on plain clickable divs, while the other pages use labelled buttons.
findings.why: They are built from div elements with on_click handlers (views/form_2551q_view.rs:1873-1915, 2170-2200 and 2494-2530), so the controls look and behave differently from the rest of the desktop forms.

options.name: Labelled buttons
options.detail: Use the same labelled button-row component as the 2550Q and 2552 pages for two- and three-option choices.

options.name: Keep radios with labels
options.detail: Keep the radio look but make the whole label row the click target and add a focus state.
